allow: PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId, @{n='Cmd';e={$_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(120,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\)}} | Format-List)
PowerShell(foreach \($id in 7448, 4384, 8356, 5164\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "stopped $id" } catch { "already gone: $id" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in 3000, 3001\) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { foreach \($conn in $c\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "port $p -> PID $\($conn.OwningProcess\) \($\($proc.ProcessName\)\)" } } else { "port $p -> free" } })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; foreach \($p in 3000, 3001\) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "port $p -> STILL IN USE by PID $\($c.OwningProcess\)" } else { "port $p -> free" } }; $left = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'ecommerce-website' }; if \($left\) { "remaining project node processes: $\($left.Count\)" } else { "no leftover project node processes" })
